summary: Anthropic launched Claude for Small Business, a package of connectors and pre-built agentic workflows integrating Claude with tools like QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva and Docusign for small business owners.

mechanisms.reason: The product runs agentic workflows that complete multi-step business tasks (payroll, invoicing, campaigns) across connected apps rather than relying on manual seat-based software use.
mechanisms.quote: It ships with 15 ready-to-run agentic workflows across finance, operations, sales, marketing, HR, and customer service.
